name: Delegate account: my delegated accounts
description: Shows authorised users how to open an account that has been delegated to them.

steps.title: My delegated accounts
steps.content:
This page lists every account that is currently delegated to you.

Everything you do while using a delegated account is recorded in the site log under both your name and the name of the account.

steps.title: Delegated account column
steps.content: This column shows the person whose account you may open. Select a name to see that person's profile.

steps.title: Access starts and Access ends columns
steps.content:
You can open the account only between these two dates.

No end date means access stays open until an administrator revokes it.

steps.title: Use delegated account button
steps.content:
Select Use delegated account, followed by the person's name, in the row of the account you need. Moodle then opens that account.

To stop working as that account, log out. You cannot open a second delegated account until you have logged out.

If the delegation ends or is revoked while you are using the account, the session closes and you must log in again.

steps.title: User menu
steps.content:
You can also open a delegated account without coming to this page. Open your user menu, which is your name and picture at the top right of the page, and select Delegated accounts. A list of your accounts opens. Select a name to use that account.

If you have more accounts than the menu can list, the list ends with View all delegated accounts, which opens this page.
